edition: MUSE — shared licensed skinned character revision 6: complexion, oral assembly and evaluated facial normals
reviewers: Character/expression agent: isolated the oral meshes, fitted the existing dental/tongue assembly, evaluated combined facial normals and reviewed all final sampled expressions/angles/playback.

Root agent: independently reviewed enlarged neutral, surprise and laughter front/three-quarter/profile captures in qa/character/portrait-v6 and accepted the complexion, dental arch and normal improvements.

scope.method: Inspected all eight six-pose sequences, all eight front/three-quarter/profile rest-and-peak comparisons, seven screenshots per expression sampled from uninterrupted playback across a loop boundary, mobile wink/surprise and the three full-body anatomical selections. Also inspected 24 enlarged peak portraits and three enlarged neutral views (camera zoom 2.15, face roughly 470 px tall in the capture), including mouth interiors and laugh corners. All contact sheets were rebuilt from the final captures. This is sampled self-review, not continuous frame-by-frame, clinical or independent artistic certification.

repairs: Preserved the CC0 MakeHuman-derived skinned body, shared adult identity, 52 official face-unit targets, same five-second acting recipes and continuous anatomical surfaces.
Kept the refined jaw contour and softened the lower-face transition consistently in both FORM and MUSE. Refreshed skin appearance and studio illumination retain the shared identity.

Isolated the bright flat mouth interior to the actual Tongue mesh. Recessed it 12 mm, lowered it 4 mm, fitted its height to 75%, retained articulation and recomputed smooth normals after a restrained subdivision pass.

Diagnosed the missing upper row as dental-assembly alignment, not absent crowns. Lowered both complete dental arches and gingiva together by 3.5 mm, preserving the bite relationship and all 58 targets. Existing smooth crown refinement remains in place.

Balanced warm ivory enamel against source gum colors and reduced posterior illumination by oral depth. Tongue color is desaturated and depth-attenuated. These are explicit local lighting approximations, not traced intraoral illumination.

Corrected the laughter cheek lighting wedge by evaluating normals from the combined expression geometry. UV seam contributions are welded; a private normal attribute preserves exact authored neutral shading and prevents cross-instance, clothing or FORM changes. The .90 laughter smile geometry remains unchanged.

The normal updater processes only relevant face triangles and changed morph weights. Tests now cover finite private normals, exact neutral restoration, normal-buffer isolation, endpoint equality and reverse seeking.

Preserved surface-conforming highlights, exact skin-anchored labels, hair fade/restoration during Back inspection, portrait/full-body framing, manual orbit interruption, responsive controls and the accepted SVG corpus.
Recaptured all final MUSE pose, angle, mobile, interaction and automatic-playback evidence, and rebuilt every current contact sheet.

studies.observations: A restrained cheek and corner lift softens the eyelids. The updated skin has quieter lower-face shading; the refined jaw stays connected in front, oblique and profile views and returns exactly to neutral.
Inner brows rise and mouth corners lower, with a small gathered lower lip. The common jaw silhouette and smooth cheek shading are preserved through the peak and recovery.
Brows lower and draw together as the lids narrow and the lips firm. Teeth remain inside the mouth, and the held and recovery samples preserve the same adult facial identity.

Widened eyes sit above a laterally stretched opening. A restrained upper incisal band now sits behind the upper lip, with a darker recessed oral cavity instead of the flat bright tongue plate. In oblique view some posterior crowns remain visible, but they are attached to the dental arch rather than floating in front of the lips.

Raised brows and widened eyes accompany a taller rounded mouth. The repositioned upper arch is visible as a narrow incisal band; lower central crowns are mostly covered, and the tongue no longer fills the opening as a bright red surface. Profile preserves a continuous lip/chin silhouette. The oblique mouth remains visibly stylized.
Asymmetric upper-lip and nose-region lift remain readable with the small head turn. The repositioned dentition forms a narrow line within the lip opening without gross clipping in the sampled views.

The viewer-left lid closes over the iris and holds while the other eye stays open. The small half smile stays attached to the cheek; both eyes and authored neutral normals restore exactly at five seconds.

The .90 smile retains its full corner and cheek lift, softened eyes and open jaw. Warm ivory upper crowns form a coherent curved row above the dark cavity. Evaluating combined facial normals removes the conspicuous triangular light wedge at the lateral mouth corner without weakening the smile. A naturalistic fold remains; this is an authored open-smile loop rather than spontaneous irregular laughter.

bodySelectionReview.observations: The full-body identity, relaxed hands and clothing are preserved. Chest and pelvis now show readable mint surfaces; the Back selection temporarily fades long hair so the true back surface is visible through it. Residual layered hair tint remains, while selecting Pelvis restores the normal hair. All three anchors follow the skin at the intended 2 mm offset, and each region produces measured mint pixels in the actual WebGL framebuffer.

mobileReview.observations: The two visible feature labels stay inside the 390 px viewport, controls remain reachable, and the portrait shows the eyelid closure or open mouth without horizontal overflow. The portrait includes upper torso rather than filling the entire viewport with the face.

limitations: The original CC0-derived adult identity is not a scan or exact likeness of Sydney Sweeney or the supplied reference portraits.
The result is an interactive stylized human character; it does not achieve the references’ premium cinematic or photographic finish.
Hair uses subdivided textured cards. Broad highlight bands, a visibly grouped hairline and clumped lower tips remain; there is no individual-strand simulation.
Skin uses corrected embedded textures and diffuse-wrap shading rather than volumetric subsurface scattering. Some geometry, facial creases and clothing boundaries remain simplified.

The oral assembly now has visible upper crowns and a recessed tongue, but posterior teeth can still look prominent in oblique open-mouth views. Oral depth darkening is an approximation, not clinically accurate anatomy or traced light transport.
Expression presets are bounded artistic performances, without spontaneous microexpressions. Emotion names do not diagnose internal states.
Surface overlays indicate approximate anatomical regions. Back inspection fades hair but retains some tint from layered cards.

One earlier full check invocation produced NaN camera/label coordinates during framing/body controls. Two focused finite-bounds/camera reproductions and the complete final rerun passed without a runtime edit. The cause was not established; this report does not claim that a bounds bug was repaired.

Performance measurements used desktop Chrome at desktop and narrow mobile viewport sizes, not a physical mobile-device benchmark. The visual review covers stated poses/angles, not every possible orbit, zoom, device or frame.

referenceMatch.status: Organic human topology, one consistent adult identity and visible facial acting; cinematic likeness and strand-level hair fidelity remain below the supplied visual references.
referenceMatch.claim: Accepted for the interactive illustrated explorer, not certified as photorealistic, medically accurate or an exact celebrity likeness.

passMeaning: Automated geometry/interactions/playback passed, and no detached facial feature, open wink aperture, gross clipping or loop discontinuity was found in the stated visual samples. This is not a photorealism or beauty score.

playbackEvidence.subsequentChanges: None. The final automatic playback, posed captures and enlarged portraits use the frozen dental assembly, tongue, skin/studio and evaluated facial normal implementation.

normalEvaluation.conditions: Desktop Chrome, 1440×1080 and 390×844 viewport; not physical-phone performance.
